gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable. P6: nothing usable.
notes: #1 (Rørbye 1844) is a Parthenon scene with Piraeus only on the horizon. #4 is an albumen print dated 1850 by the library, which looks like a placeholder date, so skipped. #3 is the second 1890s photochrom (harbor and town hall). P6 candidates (#10–#12, from Philopappos Hill) mostly show Athens with Piraeus far on the horizon; #9 is a ferry deck. #11 could serve as a weak fallback.
